In pull-request CI, a contributor can commit a highly compressed C10 ZIP and repair its origin and outer hashes; `validate_c10_archives` reads `evidence_manifest.json` and then every declared artifact before this bounded helper is invoked. Both outer validate_c10_archives and the direct content helper invoke the SAME metadata-only preflight immediately after opening a ZIP, before their first ZipFile.read (including the manifest). It enforces the authoritative exact13-member inventory,4,000,000-byte member limit and16,000,000-byte total limit.

A new durable test repairs origin/outer hashes on five small inventory/size-mutated ZIPs and spies on ZipFile.read. Both entry points reject all five with zero reads (10 negative controls); the inclusive member/total boundary controls pass. Two independent reviewers reproduced the new test and21 existing C10 regressions. All seven publisher ZIPs and all four manuscript exports remain unchanged. Strict final verification and packaging pass. Fresh29-method CI and exact-head review will run before merge; the prior28-method run is explicitly recorded as prior-head evidence.
